exact_English_labels.group_help: Rows with the same group number are satisfied by any one of them (EMT or AEMT or Paramedic); leave blank for a stand-alone requirement.

row_semantics.type: The dropdown contains active Person-scoped types, displayed as name (code). Unit types cannot be saved as personnel role requirements.
row_semantics.mandatory: Unsatisfied Mandatory rows affect Qualified and can block role addition/remove membership under Enforce. Nonmandatory unsatisfied rows are advisory; they do not independently make Qualified false.
row_semantics.blank_group: Blank/null Any-of fields create independent requirements. With both Mandatory checked, A blank and B blank means A AND B.
row_semantics.same_number: Rows sharing the same non-null Any-of number form one alternative set. Any one satisfied row passes that entire set. With both Mandatory checked, A1 and B1 means A OR B.
row_semantics.combined_sets: Separate numbered sets and blank mandatory rows must each be satisfied: A1/B1/Cblank means (A OR B) AND C. A1/B2 are separate one-row sets, not alternatives to each other.
row_semantics.distinct_types: The service retains one saved row per type; duplicate type entries are collapsed with the last row winning. An OR demonstration needs two distinct types.
row_semantics.mixed_mandatory_nuance: A satisfied row passes its numbered group regardless of other rows’ Mandatory flag. If no row passes, all failed group rows are retained, and failed mandatory rows determine Qualified. Keep both preview rows MandatoryON for a clear consistent example; no mixed-flag policy is demonstrated.
row_semantics.allow_trainee: Allow trainee accepts a typed record with Trainee status for that row. Leaving it unchecked does not permit Trainee records. Pending verification is controlled separately by department TreatPendingVerificationAsValid, currently parent-reported unchecked.
row_semantics.validity: A matching nondeleted typed Active record is valid through its expiry date. Never-expires types and typed records with no expiry are treated as open-ended. This software evaluation is not professional authorization.
row_semantics.grace: Grace override7 replaces the department30 for removal-deadline calculations on this row. It does not make a missing/expired record valid. Under Enforce, removal occurs only after the computed deadline (strictly later by date). No removal is demonstrated, and the own role has0members/globalOff.

save_and_preview_boundary.add_requirement: Add requirement is type=button. Its jQuery handler clones the hidden row template and reindexes names; it does not send a request.
save_and_preview_boundary.new_row_defaults: Mandatory checked; Any-of blank; Allow trainee unchecked; Grace override blank. The type defaults to the first current dropdown option, so explicitly choose a distinct intended type before describing the preview.
save_and_preview_boundary.remove_row: Remove-row button removes that local row and reindexes. It is not a saved deletion until the form is submitted.
save_and_preview_boundary.no_live_eligibility: The only page script adds/removes/reindexes rows; it does not re-evaluate Member eligibility while fields are edited. The pictured eligibility is server-rendered from saved requirements and existing members.
save_and_preview_boundary.save: Save is a plain HTML POST with antiforgery protection; no requirement-save native confirm or Bootstrap modal is present in this view. It replaces the entire saved type set. Omitted existing types are deleted, while retained types are updated/inserted and audited.
save_and_preview_boundary.unsaved_exit: Use the visible Back to roles link without Save, then the own role’s Required certifications launcher for a fresh readback. Do not infer discard from browser Back cached fields; read the reopened saved one-row state.

type_code_lock.server_rule: SaveCertificationType independently rejects a changed code while CountByTypeIdAsync>0. It is not only a cosmetic disabled field.
type_code_lock.scope_rule: Person/Unit scope is independently locked when any person or unit record references the type. Casey’s existing new record already caused the scope lock before the role requirement.
